d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic guest focused Housekeeping professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests. As an Assistant Housekeeping Manager you are responsible for managing and leading the Housekeeping Team, Department towards achieving the departmental goals and objectives.
q: You should be a college or university graduate with at least three years previous management experience within the Housekeeping Department of a hotel. Technically you will have fluency in both written and spoken English, whereby additional language skills would be a definite benefit and knowledge of Micros and Opera coupled with administration and organizational computer literacy skills is essential.
The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong professional with an eye for detail and a passion for high-quality hotel keeping.
You will be self-motivated, flexible and creative in order to develop innovative options in the best interest of guests and the hotel and should possess the following additional competencies
r: li
Ensure the standards of cleanliness and maintenance of the Hotel meet the specified requirements.
li

Monitor cleanliness of guest rooms, with special care for VIP and long stay Guests, and public areas to ensure compliance to the Leading Quality Assurance standards of the Hotel and monitor the release of rooms to avoid delays during check-in.
li
Investigate and attend to Guest complaints in a timely manner and follow up effectively to ensure Guest satisfaction.
li
Coordinate and monitor Preventive Maintenance Program and Spring Cleaning progress in both rooms and public areas to upkeep the properties equipment, image and upholstery.
li
Carry out the Employee Development related requirements for new joiners to ensure they settle in quickly.
li

Provide effective feedback, corrective coaching and counselling to employees based on employee performance and communicates any gross misconduct or disciplinary actions to the Department Head in order to bring the Employee back on the right track.
li

Assist Director of Housekeeping and Assistant Director of Housekeeping with the Performance Management process activities i.e. setting of KJRs, conducting Mid Year Reviews and APR to enhance performance.
li
Prepare the roster for employees directly reporting to them and clear pending days, annual leave and public holidays to ensure effective operation.
li

Maintain a safe and hazard free environment for Guests and employees by communicating any faulty equipment or dangerous situations to the Engineering, Security Department and open the safety box of check-out, vacant rooms to ensure safety of Guest belongings.
li
Operate in a safe and environmentally friendly way to protect guests' and employees' health and safety, as well as protect and conserve the environment.
li
Comply with the hotel environmental, health and safety policies and procedures.

d: An international organisation is seeking a Supply Chain Director to lead procurement, logistics and supply chain operations across a geographically diverse network.
We are conducting this search confidentially. The organisation’s identity and operating sector will be shared with suitable candidates during the recruitment process.

Applications are welcome from supply chain leaders worldwide, including candidates currently based outside the Middle East. This position is based in Kuwait and requires relocation for candidates living elsewhere.
You will connect supply chain strategy with operational delivery, ensuring that goods and services reach the right locations reliably, efficiently and with appropriate financial control.
The role requires a leader who can strengthen procurement practices, improve visibility across inventory and logistics, and build effective relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
You will balance service, cost and risk while developing the people, processes and systems needed to support operations across multiple markets.
q: You will bring senior supply chain leadership experience within a complex, international or multisite organisation.
Responsibility across several supply chain functions, including procurement and logistics.
International sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiation.
Cross-border freight, customs processes and distribution.
Inventory management, warehousing and supply planning.
Budget management, operational reporting and performance improvement.
Leadership of teams and collaboration with stakeholders across different locations.
Strong procurement governance, documentation and financial discipline.

You may currently be a Supply Chain Director, Head of Supply Chain, Procurement and Logistics Director, or a Regional Supply Chain Manager with the breadth of responsibility to take on a director-level appointment.

We welcome transferable experience from different industries. Previous employment in Kuwait or the GCC is not essential; relevant international experience and the ability to operate across markets are valued.
This opportunity is open to candidates worldwide who are willing to relocate to Kuwait.
The organisation’s operating context, detailed remit, package and relocation arrangements will be discussed confidentially during the recruitment process.
r: li
Lead supply chain strategy across procurement, sourcing, inventory, warehousing and logistics.
li
Translate operational requirements into coordinated purchasing, stock and distribution plans.
li
Strengthen supplier selection, commercial negotiation, contract management and performance review.
li
Improve demand planning, stock availability and inventory accuracy while managing excess and slow-moving stock.
li
Oversee international freight, import and export activity, customs coordination and delivery performance.
li
Develop effective relationships with logistics providers, freight forwarders and other supply chain partners.
li
Establish clear procurement controls, approval processes and reporting standards.
li
Identify supply risks and develop contingency plans to protect operational continuity.
li
Monitor expenditure, supplier performance, lead times and service levels, using data to guide improvements.
li
Work closely with finance and operational teams to align priorities, budgets and delivery requirements.
li
Lead and develop supply chain teams, establishing accountability and consistent working practices.
li
Improve systems and management information to provide greater visibility across the supply chain.
